display_long_description:
# Welcome to GO SLED, the ultimate VR snow-sliding adventure! 🛷 

Use your own arms to push, steer, and balance as you glide across snowy slopes. Feel the speed, carve through the mountain, and choose your path as you explore a huge winter playground. ❄️

[media]

**🏔️ Explore the mountain**

It's a generated map! You can go down as much as you want and the mountain never ends.

**💰 Collect gold coins**

Grab coins along the way to upgrade your stamina, letting you ride longer, faster, and reach places you couldn’t before.

**💪 Move to go further**

The more you move, the better you get. Master your rhythm, improve your control, and beat your own distance records.

[media]

**Ready to hit the mountain?**

# GO SLED and see how far you can go! 🏔️🛷❄️
